schedule-candidates.title: Adding candidates to a schedule
changed: **Selections are kept** when you search or filter again. The footer shows how many candidates you have selected.
**Filter by hierarchy, role or label** in the selection window.
**The selection window stays open after Add.** A confirmation shows how many candidates were added, so you can add the next batch straight away. Click Close when you are done.
**Search and filter the candidates on a schedule** from the Candidates tab. The Filter button shows how many filters are on.
schedule-candidates.where: **Delivering > [schedule title] > Candidates**, then click **Add candidates** to open the selection window.
schedule-candidates.summary: A new selection window for adding candidates to a schedule.
